name: fig_principles

Five equal horizontal rounded bars stacked vertically, filling the canvas. Each bar has a colored square number badge on the left (navy, showing 一 二 三 四 五 respectively), then a bold Chinese principle name, then a thin vertical divider, then smaller gray Chinese explanatory text.

Bar 1: name 育人主体地位　explanation 教材编写与审定由教师和专家主导
Bar 2: name 证据优先　explanation 交付材料必须挂载来源与定位信息
Bar 3: name 体系视角　explanation 分析教材体系的覆盖结构时效自主
Bar 4: name 人机分工　explanation 绿黄红三色灯明确责任边界
Bar 5: name 全程留痕　explanation 检索确认决策全过程可追溯

name: fig_flow
prompt:
A clean flat-vector flowchart for a Chinese technical design document. IMPORTANT: do NOT draw any title, heading, or caption text anywhere — the diagram has no title. Pure white background. Palette: deep navy #1B3A6B, crimson #C42B1C, green #2E7D32, gold #C9A227, gray #8A8F98. Bold crisp Chinese sans-serif typography, perfectly legible. Thin precise connector lines with small arrowheads. No shadows, no gradients.

Top-down flow:
1. A navy rounded box: 使用者提出任务
2. Arrow down to a navy diamond: 任务解析枢
3. The diamond branches into THREE labelled paths side by side:
   - Left branch labelled 研究型 leading to a green box: 直接受理
   - Middle branch labelled 撰写型 leading to a gold box: 任务转译 改写为助研任务
   - Right branch labelled 超出范围 leading to a gray box: 说明理由 不予受理
4. The green box and the gold box both flow down into one navy box: 检索·比对·评估引擎
5. Arrow down to a navy rectangle labelled 输出规范枢, containing four small white sub-boxes in a row with Chinese text: 引证覆盖率 / 无引证长度 / 形态符合度 / 摘录长度
6. From it, two arrows: left arrow labelled 通过 to a green box: 交付证据包 ; right arrow labelled 不通过 to a gold box: 形态归一为卡片清单
7. Both flow down into one gray box at the bottom: 全过程留痕存证
